div.p: mise is the human entrypoint. tools/Build.java is the build authority. There is no Maven, Gradle, npm install, bundler, or JavaScript build system.

pre.code: mise install mise run check mise run dev mise run test [paths...] mise run verify

ul.li: sources: production Java, templates, runtime assets.
tests: JUnit tests, snapshots, anonymized dev corpus.
output: disposable generated artifacts, never source.

div.p: .github/golems defines bounded maintenance tasks for Pi, Claude Code, and Codex CLI. Runs use dedicated golem/<task-id> branches and PRs, never direct trunk repair.
